title: With God We Shall Do Valiantly

questions.question: My heart is steadfast, O God! I will sing and make melody with all my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:1 (ESV): "My heart is steadfast, O God! I will sing and make melody with all my being!"

questions.question: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:2 (ESV): "Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn!"

questions.question: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises to you among the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:3 (ESV): "...I will sing praises to you among the nations."

questions.question: For your steadfast love is great above the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:4 (ESV): "...your faithfulness reaches to the clouds."

questions.question: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:5 (ESV): "...Let your glory be over all the earth!"

questions.question: That your beloved ones may be delivered, give salvation by your right hand and answer whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:6 (ESV): "...give salvation by your right hand and answer me!"

questions.question: God has promised in his holiness: "With exultation I will divide up Shechem and portion out the Vale of what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:7 (ESV): "...and portion out the Vale of Succoth."

questions.question: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my what?
Moab is my washbasin; upon Edom I cast my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:9 (ESV): "...upon Edom I cast my shoe;"

questions.question: Over Philistia I shout in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:9 (ESV): "over Philistia I shout in triumph."

questions.question: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:10 (ESV): "Who will lead me to Edom?"

questions.question: Have you not rejected us, O God? You do not go out, O God, with our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:11 (ESV): "...You do not go out, O God, with our armies."

questions.question: Oh grant us help against the foe, for vain is the salvation of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:12 (ESV): "...for vain is the salvation of man!"

questions.question: With God we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:13 (ESV): "...it is he who will tread down our foes."

questions.question: This Psalm is composed of parts from which two other Psalms?
questions.explanation: Psalm 108:1-5 matches Psalm 57:7-11, and Psalm 108:6-13 matches Psalm 60:5-12.

key_verse_text: With God we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our foes.
